events.title: 초나라 하상에서 태어나다
events.title_en: Born in Xiaxiang, State of Chu
events.description: 옛 초나라 땅 하상에서 태어났다. 대대로 초나라 장군을 지낸 항씨 가문의 후손이었다.
events.description_en: He was born in Xiaxiang, in the territory of the old state of Chu. He came from the Xiang family, which had produced generals of Chu for generations.

events.title: 만 명을 대적하는 법을 배우겠다 말하다
events.title_en: He said he wanted to learn to face ten thousand men
events.description: 어려서 부모를 잃고 숙부 항량 밑에서 자랐다. 글도 검술도 도중에 그만두고는, 한 사람만 상대하는 재주 말고 만 명을 대적하는 법을 배우겠다고 말했다.
events.description_en: Orphaned young, he was raised by his uncle Xiang Liang. He gave up both writing and swordsmanship midway, saying he wanted to learn not how to face one man but how to face ten thousand.

events.title: 숙부와 함께 회계에서 군사를 일으키다
events.title_en: He rose in arms with his uncle at Kuaiji
events.description: 진나라에 맞선 봉기가 곳곳에서 일어나자 숙부 항량과 함께 회계에서 군을 일으켰다. 항우가 그 자리에서 태수를 베어 거사의 신호탄을 쏘았다.
events.description_en: As revolts against the Qin dynasty broke out across the land, he rose in arms with his uncle Xiang Liang at Kuaiji. Xiang Yu cut down the local governor on the spot, the opening blow of their uprising.

events.title: 숙부가 전사하자 군을 이어받다
events.title_en: He took command after his uncle fell in battle
events.description: 진나라 장수 장한과 싸우던 숙부 항량이 정도에서 전사했다. 항우가 남은 군을 이어받아 지휘했다.
events.description_en: His uncle Xiang Liang fell in battle against the Qin general Zhang Han at Dingtao. Xiang Yu took over command of the remaining army.

events.title: 거록에서 진나라 주력군을 무너뜨리다
events.title_en: He crushed the main Qin army at Julu
events.description: 거록에서 진나라 대군에 포위된 조나라를 구하러 나섰다. 강을 건넌 뒤 배와 솥을 부숴 물러설 길을 끊고 싸워 진나라 주력군을 무너뜨렸다.
events.description_en: He marched to relieve the state of Zhao, besieged by a massive Qin army at Julu. After crossing the river he smashed the boats and cooking pots to cut off any retreat, then broke the main Qin army in the fighting that followed.

events.title: 홍문에서 유방과 마주 앉다
events.title_en: He sat across from Liu Bang at Hongmen
events.description: 관중에 먼저 들어간 유방과 홍문에서 연회를 열었다. 참모 범증이 유방을 죽이라 거듭 권했으나 항우는 끝내 손을 쓰지 않았다.
events.description_en: He held a banquet at Hongmen with Liu Bang, who had entered the Guanzhong region first. His advisor Fan Zeng repeatedly urged him to kill Liu Bang there, but Xiang Yu never gave the order.

events.title: 서초패왕을 칭하고 천하를 나누다
events.title_en: He declared himself Hegemon-King of Western Chu and divided the realm
events.description: 진나라 궁궐을 불태우고 스스로 서초패왕이라 칭했다. 각지의 장수들을 왕으로 봉해 천하를 열여덟으로 나누었다.
events.description_en: He burned the Qin palace and declared himself Hegemon-King of Western Chu. He enfeoffed his generals as kings across the land, dividing the realm into eighteen states.

events.title: 해하에서 사방에서 들려오는 초나라 노래에 둘러싸이다
events.title_en: He was surrounded at Gaixia by Chu songs sung from every side
events.description: 유방의 연합군에게 해하에서 겹겹이 포위됐다. 밤마다 사방에서 초나라 노래가 들려오자 병사들은 고향이 이미 유방 손에 넘어갔다고 여겨 하나둘 도망쳤다.
events.description_en: He was surrounded at Gaixia by Liu Bang's allied armies. Night after night, Chu songs rose from every side of the camp, and his soldiers, believing their homeland had already fallen, slipped away one by one.

events.title: 오강에서 스스로 목숨을 끊다
events.title_en: He took his own life at the Wu River
events.description: 남은 기병을 이끌고 포위를 뚫어 오강까지 갔다. 강동으로 건너가 훗날을 도모하라는 권유를 뿌리치고, 고향 사람들을 볼 낯이 없다며 스스로 목숨을 끊었다. 서른 살이었다.
events.description_en: He broke through the encirclement with his remaining cavalry and reached the Wu River. He refused the offer to cross into Jiangdong and try again, saying he could not face his own people, and took his own life there. He was thirty.
